confirmed.claim: The apparition's avatar form (Cosmic Notary) reaches the player only as prose in the apparition's description; WG writes the form onto the Avatar spell itself through the apparition's Primary mode, so a 19th-level animist casting avatar through Supreme Incarnation sees the form on the spell card, which our sheet never shows.
confirmed.printed: Avatar Cosmic Notary Speed 30 feet, fly 50 feet; Melee (1 action) burning pen (agile, reach 15 feet, versatile fire), Damage 6d6+6 piercing; Ranged (1 action) exacting language (fatal d10, mental, range 60 feet), Damage 6d6+6 mental. (Supreme Incarnation, class feature 19: "When you cast avatar in this way, you do not become an avatar of a deity; rather, your primary attuned apparition incarnates itself using your body, transforming you into the avatar described in your primary attuned apparition's entry.")
confirmed.ours: classes.animist.extraChoices[apparition].options['lamentation-of-sinister-deals'].description carries the Cosmic Notary block as prose only; classFeatures['lamentation-of-sinister-deals'] has no spellNotes, the core.json modes bucket has no avatar mode for any apparition, and nothing annotates spells['avatar'].
confirmed.theirs: Primary mode (their id 57495, reached from the feat's giveAbilityBlock type=mode): {"type":"injectText","data":{"type":"spell","id":4407,"text":"**Lamentation of Sinister Deals** _Cosmic Notary_ Speed 30 feet, fly 50 feet; **Melee** <abbr cost=\"ONE-ACTION\" class=\"action-symbol\">1</abbr> burning pen ([agile](link_trait_1569), [reach 15 feet](link_trait_4174), versatile [fire](link_trait_1542)), **Damage** 6d6+6 piercing; **Ranged** <abbr cost=\"ONE-ACTION\" class=\"action-symbol\">1</abbr> exacting language ([fatal d10](link_trait_3199), [mental](link_trait_1448), range 60 feet), **Damage** 6d6+6 [mental](link_trait_1448)"}} (WG spell 4407 = Avatar, rank 10)
confirmed.proposal: Add to scripts/data/effect-backfill.json {category:'classFeatures', id:'lamentation-of-sinister-deals', field:'spellNotes', value:[{spellId:'avatar', note:'If this is your primary apparition and you cast avatar with your Supreme Incarnation slot, you take its avatar form, Cosmic Notary: Speed 30 feet, fly 50 feet; Melee [one-action] burning pen (agile, reach 15 feet, versatile fire), Damage 6d6+6 piercing; Ranged [one-action] exacting language (fatal d10, mental, range 60 feet), Damage 6d6+6 mental.'}]}. The N2 spellNotes pass (build.ts:7432) already walks this record: an attuned apparition's option is in chosenOptions/grantOptions, so classFeatureIdsOwned puts classFeatures['lamentation-of-sinister-deals'] into ownedRecords. That pass has no primary-apparition gate, so the note text states the primary condition itself. This is the same gap b034 found on monarch-of-the-fey-courts#avatar, and the fix belongs on all 14 apparitions in one lane.
confirmed.evidence: wg-show "Lamentation of Sinister Deals - Primary" --raw shows injectText type=spell id=4407 with the Cosmic Notary line, and row 4407 in work/wg/wg-data.sql is Avatar (rank 10, divine); Supreme Incarnation (class-feature-1056) prints that avatar cast takes the primary apparition's form. Our classFeatures['lamentation-of-sinister-deals'] carries no spellNotes, no classFeatures record has an avatar spellNote, 'Cosmic Notary' exists only in the apparition's description, and spells['avatar'] has no note, so the SpellsTab detail (spellNotesFor) never shows it. The b034 refutation of monarch-of-the-fey-courts#avatar rejected a different claim (mode with Speeds/Strikes); this claim concedes WG's side is prose and names only where it renders.
